title: T1189 — Drive-by Compromise
subtitle: A watering-hole attack against an employee reading an industry blog.

steps.title: Normal morning
steps.caption: An employee reads a trusted industry blog over coffee. Nothing looks wrong.
steps.defender: normal browsing; nothing to alert on yet.

steps.title: The trap was set earlier
steps.caption: A week before, attackers compromised the blog and added a hidden one-pixel iframe pointing at their landing server.
steps.defender: if you operate the site, file-integrity monitoring catches the iframe; as a visitor you cannot see it.
